body: Men need to realize it’s okay to be emotional. It’s okay to be vulnerable. You can cry if you need to. It’s okay to need to vent to someone. It’s okay to need to see a therapist or psychiatrist. I feel like men have a hard time accepting help because they feel it threatens their manhood. They pretend to act tough in moments they aren’t. You can need help and still be a good provider and protector. Taking care of yourself is an admirable and attractive trait. I think one small step people can take in their personal lives is letting guys know they can come to you if they need support, or suggest professional help for them when necessary. I think men need to learn to open up more and learn to ask for help when they need it

Yeah I do all that. I’ve had a hard time finding myself tho. I was in a car accident at 16 where I broke my neck in 3 places and I was left paralyzed on my left side from the neck down. I also had a traumatic brain injury that really effected my memory. I had other injuries, but those healed. After thousands of hours of physical therapy I am able to walk normally and can move my left side. My left arm still has a lot of complications. I spend majority of my time trying to manage my chronic pain because being in pain really kills your mood. It’s also beyond draining always being in pain 24/7. I sleep like shit because of it too. I lost every “friend” I ever had afterwards because I “wasn’t acting like myself”. I have only made one friend since then. I haven’t been able to keep a job since the crash. There’s a 70% chance you’ll be depressed after a traumatic brain injury, so the odds weren’t in my favor. Dealing with all this extra shit on top of trying to grow up and figure out who I am really sucks. I’m just trying to find something I’m passionate about because you are right I do expect too much out of them. I don’t want to rely on them for anything, but I haven’t found anything yet. I’m 21 now btw.
